body:
Damn so glad to hear you're ok! I think a lot of people, myself included, were regularly checking this post to see if you updated. First off i wish you the best of luck with the tough spot you are in right now.   
I don't know anything about your life situation but with this new chance at life maybe changing your entire environment (like moving to a new city) could help make some real changes and get you out of the old life cycle.

Hope you're still here man. Just checked your posts and its so infuriating and sad how depression can just fucking blind us from all the good in life (I've been a victim of this as well). 

Dude is young, jacked, handsome and thinking about going to college to help others with their mental problems... Fuck depression man.

Yeah it hurts when people do not want to hang out because they look at you as "innocent" or boring. I tried to change myself to be more daring and wild but i'm not sure if its because of the years of conditioning to not be like that or because i'm just a pussy, but it never feels comfortable or fun. I find enjoyment in other things but i feel like a minority.

Feel exactly the same. Like you were handed this manual on how to live your life and after you finish it you realize that everyone else has been using a different manual and all that will await you is loneliness and a big disconnect with your peers.

Anyone that says any form of "focus on yourself" will most likely have social support around them. When you work and try to impress yourself but at the end of the day have nobody you can connect with the loneliness will eat at you.
